question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list the occasions on which the square was given a name, whether its first name or a renaming, in chronological order.
why_needs_multiple: Đáp án là ba lần đặt tên/đổi tên của quảng trường, cần liệt kê đủ ba mốc.
criterion: the square is given a name, either its initial name or a new name by renaming

gold_events.text: Square given the name Gutenbergplatz after Johannes Gutenberg.
Square renamed Auguste-Viktoria-Platz after the German Empress.
Square given the new name Breitscheidplatz after Rudolf Breitscheid.
